info.name: TaskForge API
info.description: Comprehensive cookie-authenticated verification workflow. Run requests in order against a freshly migrated and seeded local stack. Authentication remains in Postman's cookie jar; only workflow identifiers, versions, the CSRF value, and the local upload path are collection variables. Set filePath to a valid local PNG, JPEG, WebP, or PDF before running the file-upload request (the automated verification supplies a temporary PNG).

exec: pm.test('API process is live', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('Liveness reports unchecked dependencies', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('requestId'); pm.expect(body.data.status).to.equal('alive'); pm.expect(body.data.dependencies).to.deep.equal({ redis: 'unchecked', postgres: 'unchecked', queue: 'unchecked' }); });
pm.test('Dependencies are ready', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('Readiness identifies PostgreSQL and Redis', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('requestId'); pm.expect(body.data).to.deep.include({ status: 'ready', dependencies: { postgres: 'ok', redis: 'ok', queue: 'ok' } }); });
pm.test('CSRF cookie is issued', () => pm.response.to.have.status(204));

pm.test('CSRF value is available for mutations', () => { const token = pm.cookies.get('tf_csrf'); pm.expect(token, 'tf_csrf cookie').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.collectionVariables.set('csrfToken', token); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('registeredEmail', `postman-${Date.now()}@taskforge.local`);
pm.test('User registration creates a session', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));

pm.test('Registration returns a public USER identity', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('requestId'); pm.expect(body.data.user).to.include({ email: pm.collectionVariables.get('registeredEmail'), role: 'USER' }); pm.expect(body.data.user).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(body.data.user).not.to.have.property('passwordHash'); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('csrfToken', pm.cookies.get('tf_csrf') || '');
pm.test('Registered session is restored', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('Current user matches the registration', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('requestId'); pm.expect(body.data.user).to.include({ email: pm.collectionVariables.get('registeredEmail'), role: 'USER' }); });
pm.test('Refresh rotates the browser session', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('Refresh confirms success without exposing a token', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('requestId'); pm.expect(body.data).to.deep.equal({ refreshed: true }); pm.expect(body.data).not.to.have.property('token'); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('csrfToken', pm.cookies.get('tf_csrf') || '');
pm.test('Session is revoked', () => pm.response.to.have.status(204));
pm.collectionVariables.set('csrfToken', '');
pm.test('CSRF cookie is reissued', () => pm.response.to.have.status(204));
pm.test('CSRF value is captured', () => { const token = pm.cookies.get('tf_csrf'); pm.expect(token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.collectionVariables.set('csrfToken', token); });
pm.test('Seeded USER authenticates', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('Login returns the seeded public user', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('requestId'); pm.expect(body.data.user).to.include({ email: 'user@taskforge.local', role: 'USER' }); pm.expect(body.data.user).to.have.property('id'); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('csrfToken', pm.cookies.get('tf_csrf') || '');

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Postman smoke task",
  "description": "Created through the comprehensive collection",
  "type": "TEXT_PROCESSING",
  "input": { "schemaVersion": 1, "text": "TaskForge keeps asynchronous state truthful." },
  "maxAttempts": 3
}

exec: pm.test('Text task is durably accepted', () => pm.response.to.have.status(202));

pm.test('Accepted task is pending and versioned', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('requestId'); pm.expect(body.data.task).to.include({ type: 'TEXT_PROCESSING', status: 'PENDING', version: 1 }); pm.expect(body.data.task).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(body.data.attachments).to.deep.equal([]); pm.collectionVariables.set('taskId', body.data.task.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('taskVersion', String(body.data.task.version)); });
pm.test('Owned task detail is available', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('Task detail includes a versioned snapshot and ETag', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('requestId'); pm.expect(body.data.task.id).to.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get('taskId')); pm.expect(body.data.task).to.have.property('version'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('ETag')).to.match(/^"\d+-\d+"$/); });
pm.test('Task history is available', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('Task history exposes append-only events', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('requestId'); pm.expect(body.data.events).to.be.an('array').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.data.events[0]).to.include.keys('id', 'taskId', 'type', 'executionVersion', 'occurredAt'); });

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Postman scheduled task",
  "description": "Pending fixture for versioned mutation examples",
  "type": "TEXT_PROCESSING",
  "input": { "schemaVersion": 1, "text": "This task is deliberately scheduled far in the future." },
  "scheduledAt": "2099-01-15T09:00:00.000Z",
  "maxAttempts": 3
}

exec: pm.test('Scheduled task is durably accepted', () => pm.response.to.have.status(202));

pm.test('Scheduled task remains pending with a future time', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('requestId'); pm.expect(body.data.task).to.include({ title: 'Postman scheduled task', status: 'PENDING', version: 1 }); pm.expect(new Date(body.data.task.scheduledAt).getTime()).to.be.above(Date.now()); pm.collectionVariables.set('scheduledTaskId', body.data.task.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('scheduledTaskVersion', String(body.data.task.version)); });

item.name: 14 - Search, filter, sort, and paginate owned tasks

exec: pm.test('Owned task list supports query controls', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('List metadata and filtered scheduled task are present', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('requestId'); pm.expect(body.meta).to.include({ page: 1, pageSize: 1 }); pm.expect(body.meta).to.include.keys('totalItems', 'totalPages'); pm.expect(body.data.tasks).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(body.data.tasks[0]).to.include({ id: pm.collectionVariables.get('scheduledTaskId'), status: 'PENDING', type: 'TEXT_PROCESSING' }); });
pm.test('User dashboard is available', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('Dashboard returns durable counts and queue context', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('requestId'); pm.expect(body.data.counts).to.include.keys('total', 'pending', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed'); pm.expect(body.data.queue).to.include.keys('waiting', 'delayed', 'active', 'available'); });
pm.test('Current version updates a pending task', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('Update increments the row version', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('requestId'); pm.expect(body.data.task).to.include({ id: pm.collectionVariables.get('scheduledTaskId'), title: 'Postman scheduled task updated', status: 'PENDING', version: 2 }); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('ETag')).to.match(/^"2-\d+"$/); pm.collectionVariables.set('updatedScheduledTaskVersion', String(body.data.task.version)); });
pm.test('Stale version is rejected', () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));

pm.test('Stale conflict has the stable error code', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('requestId'); pm.expect(body.error).to.include({ code: 'TASK_VERSION_CONFLICT' }); });
pm.test('Current version soft-deletes the task', () => pm.response.to.have.status(204));
pm.test('Delete response has no body', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.equal(''));
pm.test('Deleted task is no longer readable', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));

pm.test('Concealed task uses the stable not-found code', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('requestId'); pm.expect(body.error).to.include({ code: 'TASK_NOT_FOUND' }); });
pm.test('Seeded failed task is available to its owner', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('Fixture is eligible for a new execution', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('requestId'); pm.expect(body.data.task).to.include({ id: pm.collectionVariables.get('failedTaskId'), status: 'FAILED', executionVersion: 1, version: 1 }); pm.collectionVariables.set('failedTaskVersion', String(body.data.task.version)); });
pm.test('Failed task retry is accepted', () => pm.response.to.have.status(202));

pm.test('Retry starts a new pending execution', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('requestId'); pm.expect(body.data.task).to.include({ id: pm.collectionVariables.get('failedTaskId'), status: 'PENDING', executionVersion: 2, attemptsMade: 0, version: 2 }); });
pm.test('Invalid task payload is rejected', () => pm.response.to.have.status(422));

pm.test('Validation error is structured and safe', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('requestId'); pm.expect(body.error).to.include({ code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED' }); pm.expect(body.error.details).to.be.an('array').and.not.empty; });
pm.test('Invalid CSRF token is rejected', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));
pm.test('CSRF error uses the stable code', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('requestId'); pm.expect(body.error).to.include({ code: 'CSRF_INVALID' }); });
pm.test('Verified file task is accepted', () => pm.response.to.have.status(202));

pm.test('Upload returns safe attachment metadata', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('requestId'); pm.expect(body.data.task).to.include({ type: 'FILE_INSPECTION', status: 'PENDING' }); pm.expect(body.data.attachments).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(body.data.attachments[0]).to.include.keys('id', 'originalName', 'mimeType', 'sizeBytes'); pm.expect(body.data.attachments[0]).not.to.have.property('storageKey'); pm.collectionVariables.set('fileTaskId', body.data.task.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('attachmentId', body.data.attachments[0].id); });
pm.test('Owner can download the private attachment', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('Download uses safe private-file headers', () => { const contentType = pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type'); pm.expect(['image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp', 'application/pdf'].some((type) => contentType.startsWith(type))).to.equal(true); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Disposition')).to.match(/^attachment;/); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('X-Content-Type-Options')).to.equal('nosniff'); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Cache-Control')).to.equal('private, no-store'); pm.expect(Number(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Length'))).to.be.above(0); });
pm.test('CSRF cookie is available for outsider registration', () => pm.response.to.have.status(204));
pm.test('CSRF value is captured', () => { const token = pm.cookies.get('tf_csrf'); pm.expect(token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.collectionVariables.set('csrfToken', token); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('outsiderEmail', `postman-outsider-${Date.now()}@taskforge.local`);
pm.test('Outsider registration creates a separate USER session', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));

pm.test('Outsider identity is public and distinct', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('requestId'); pm.expect(body.data.user).to.include({ email: pm.collectionVariables.get('outsiderEmail'), role: 'USER' }); pm.collectionVariables.set('csrfToken', pm.cookies.get('tf_csrf') || ''); });
pm.test('Other users cannot discover the attachment', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));
pm.test('Cross-owner download is concealed', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('requestId'); pm.expect(body.error).to.include({ code: 'FILE_NOT_FOUND' }); });
pm.test('CSRF cookie is available for admin login', () => pm.response.to.have.status(204));
pm.test('CSRF value is captured', () => { const token = pm.cookies.get('tf_csrf'); pm.expect(token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.collectionVariables.set('csrfToken', token); });
pm.test('Seeded ADMIN authenticates', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('Login returns the admin role', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('requestId'); pm.expect(body.data.user).to.include({ email: 'admin@taskforge.local', role: 'ADMIN' }); pm.collectionVariables.set('csrfToken', pm.cookies.get('tf_csrf') || ''); });
pm.test('Admin dashboard is available', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('Admin dashboard returns global aggregates and queue context', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('requestId'); pm.expect(body.data.counts).to.include.keys('total', 'pending', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed'); pm.expect(body.data.queue).to.include.keys('waiting', 'delayed', 'active', 'available'); pm.expect(body.data.counts.total).to.be.at.least(4); });
pm.test('Admin global task list is available', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('Admin list contains global task snapshots', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('requestId'); pm.expect(body.data.tasks).to.be.an('array').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.data.tasks[0]).to.include.keys('id', 'ownerId', 'status', 'type', 'version'); });
pm.test('Admin session is revoked', () => pm.response.to.have.status(204));
pm.collectionVariables.set('csrfToken', '');
pm.test('Unauthenticated requests are rejected', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
pm.test('Authentication error is structured', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.property('requestId'); pm.expect(body.error).to.include({ code: 'AUTH_REQUIRED' }); });
